summary: The selected profile-2 sync source inventories its revision link as a manifest artifact and marks current authoring sessions. Normal sync fails closed when that link or role is missing. Explicit adoption is limited to the closed pre-sync 2.5.4 profile-2 producer inventory: it validates the original artifact/source closure, runs staged model and real reducer checks, rechecks original bytes under the authority lock, then journals only manifest and link writes and runs fresh sync. The link retains the old manifest digest and begins revision zero as a newly observed baseline; earlier revision history is unknown. Bounded local controls cover source mutation, stripped-current refusal, crash recovery and repeated revisions. These are source-window results only; exact-head hosted qualification, public-package fresh/retained installation and publication remain open. Local hashes do not authenticate a complete authority rewrite.
title: Profile-2 sync authority and explicit retained adoption
